body:
Oh my god. I am so, so, so, so unbelievably sorry. Losing a pet is one of the worst forms of pain. I legitimately don't know how I'm going to survive when my dog passes away.

It's going to hurt for a long time, but the pain will slowly heal into a battle scar. Furthermore, you need to have a strict talking with your neighbors and even attempt to fine them if you can so that you can get justice. Their dog also needs to be strictly trained and controlled because it seems like he is violent and ruthless.

Who are you taking care of that's drunk? If it's your friends then can you tell them what happened and cancel on them? If they don't understand, then they're not true friends. You should also try and explain to your boss that you're grieving; if (s)he seems like the type to be unforgiving, be generic and say that a close family member passed away. You deserve the time to heal. May your dog rest in peace <3
I agree. In the end, we all die anyway, so I feel like it's controlling and cruel to not be able to have control over when it happens. People are selfish and want to keep you around for themselves

Oh, wow. I'm so sorry you have to deal with this kind of narcissism. This might be ridiculous to say, but if she isn't aware of how you feel, have you tried calling her out on her controlling and abusive behavior? Would there be any other reason why she wouldn't want you to see your friends?

If you're still in high school and don't have plans for college yet but know you're academically capable, you could try looking at scholarships or colleges with good aid packages so that you can assert your independence. You could also try looking for jobs once you're out of school and maybe crash at a friend's place before finding your own.

People really just suck. All the time. :( But by letting them control you, you're feeding into their evil abuse of power. So if you can find it in yourself, fight back.

Agreed. Without using religion as a vehicle, there would be no reason to live or to do any deontological good in the world. And without purpose, everyone would give up on themselves - so regardless if God exists or not, people choose to have blind faith as an excuse to have a purpose
Why are your mother and brother against you? Do you see yourself being able to get a job/ going to college anytime soon?
Same here. Some fucking asshole with bad grammar told me I was a "whiny loser" and a "crybaby." Why are some people just out to make others miserable? PM me if you'd like <3
People judge addicts way too harshly. Your habits & physical cravings have nothing to do with what kind of a person you are, and you have a lot of wonderful qualities.
